svg.text: Architect 2.0 — what this repo runs today
Next.js on Vercel · Supabase · Vercel Sandbox · Groq. Each box is tagged Real, Partly or Demo. Compare with docs/architecture.svg (the production design).
renders the app from its saved plan
5 · browser calls buildStep in a loop

Flow: 1 prompt → server action · 2 questions + plan via the gateway · 3 connect (Calendar OAuth, key vault) · 4 sandbox + scaffold + install · 5 build loop (one model call + tools per step) · 6 preview iframe → :3000
7 changes rerun the agent in the same sandbox · 8 GitHub commit / PR · 9 deploy gate (scan, version, go live) · 10 visitors get the app rendered from its saved plan
Measured: a 2–3 screen app builds in ~60–75 s for ~15k tokens (≈ $0.003); a change in the same sandbox takes ~30 s.
Not built yet (see production diagram): queue workers + SSE · own preview proxy · egress proxy · upload to hosting + per-app database · GitHub App + webhooks · tool proxy
